notes: Model number per spec sheet: NGS-4U-V2. The E2 Gen 2 is a fully modular, build-to-order chassis (8 input-card slots + 4 output-card slots); the ports listed here represent the maximum documented I/O density from Barco's official spec sheet (last updated 27 Nov 2025), not a fixed fixed-port unit — a given unit may ship with fewer/different cards. Input SDI/HDMI/DisplayPort counts (16 SDI, 12 HDMI, 12 DP) are the max across 8 input cards; output counts (4 SDI, 13 HDMI, 1 DP) are the max across 4 output cards — actual simultaneous totals are capped at 40 in / 18 out combined. SDI ports are multi-rate SD/HD/3G/6G/12G; grade set to sdi-12g (top of stated range) per port since the spec does not separate individual BNCs by max rate. HDMI input/output rated "up to 600 MHz" (TMDS clock), consistent with HDMI 2.0 (18 Gbps class) — mapped to hdmi-2.0; note the spec sheet does not use the "2.0"/"2.1" version label for outputs, only "up to 600 MHz," so this is a close inference. DisplayPort input stated as "DisplayPort 1.2 (600 MHz max)" -> dp-1.2; output DisplayPort stated only as "up to 660 MHz" with no version number, also mapped to dp-1.2 as the closest/most conservative match (inferred). Genlock: analog reference in/loop on BNC (bi-level/blackburst SD, tri-level HD) — no bandwidth grade applies to genlock BNCs so grade omitted. S3D Sync uses 4x input and 2x output DIN connectors — DIN mini-connector has no exact match in the allowed connector list; mapped to the closest available id "midi-din" and flagged as an approximation (these are not MIDI ports). Ethernet is RJ-45, 1000/100/10 Mbps autosense -> eth-1g. Power: spec sheet states "100-240Vac, 50/60Hz, 12-5A (x2), 1,100W, dual-redundant hot-swappable power supplies" but does not explicitly name the IEC inlet variant; Barco's own spare-parts catalog lists C20-C19 power cables for the E2/Encore3 power-supply family, consistent with a high-current inlet rather than standard C13/C14, so the AC inputs are mapped to iec-c19 (closest available id) for each of the two redundant power supplies — this specific inlet variant is inferred, not spec-sheet-stated verbatim. No USB or RS232 control ports are listed on the E2 Gen 2 spec sheet; control is via Ethernet (WebUI / Event Master software / controllers) only.

ports.name: SDI In (x16)
ports.note: Up to 16 SD/HD/3G/6G/12G-SDI input connectors across up to 8 input cards; multi-rate per BNC, 12G is the top stated rate

ports.name: HDMI In (x12)
ports.note: Up to 12 HDMI inputs across input cards, rated up to 600 MHz max (HDMI 2.0 class); each input card supports up to 2x 4K@60p

ports.name: DisplayPort In (x12)
ports.note: Up to 12 DisplayPort 1.2 inputs (600 MHz max) across input cards

ports.name: SDI Out (x4)
ports.note: Up to 4 SD/HD/3G/6G/12G-SDI outputs across up to 4 output cards

ports.name: HDMI Out (x13)
ports.note: Up to 13 HDMI outputs, up to 600 MHz; includes Multiviewer HDMI outputs when MVR option installed

ports.name: DisplayPort Out
ports.note: 1 x DisplayPort output, up to 660 MHz (version not explicitly stated by Barco; mapped to closest grade)

ports.name: Reference In/Loop
ports.note: Analog genlock reference input/loop-through on BNC; bi-level and blackburst at SD, tri-level at HD

ports.name: 3D Sync In (x4)
ports.note: S3D Sync input, DIN connector x4; DIN is not in the allowed connector list, mapped to closest id (not a MIDI port)

ports.name: 3D Sync Out (x2)
ports.note: S3D Sync output, DIN connector x2; DIN is not in the allowed connector list, mapped to closest id (not a MIDI port)

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: RJ-45, 1000/100/10 Mbps autosense; used for Event Master software, controllers, and WebUI

ports.name: AC In (PSU 1)
ports.note: Redundant hot-swappable power supply 1 of 2; 100-240Vac 50/60Hz, up to 12A; exact IEC inlet variant inferred from Barco's C19/C20 spare power cable listings for this product family, not stated verbatim on spec sheet

ports.name: AC In (PSU 2)
ports.note: Redundant hot-swappable power supply 2 of 2; 100-240Vac 50/60Hz, up to 12A; exact IEC inlet variant inferred, see PSU 1 note
